text: Binary per-row measure on the OP's own title and argument (current supplied text, including marked edits): 1 if the OP makes at least one distant third-person observation, meaning a detached description of other people, groups, institutions, society or events from an external standpoint, without personal involvement or self-disclosure. 0 if the text is assessable and has no such observation. Quotations of other users are ignored unless the OP adopts them as their own observation. OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you or resolution updates, and text reporting whether the view changed are excluded as evidence. Generic discussion of delta or platform rules is neither evidence nor an outcome announcement. Do not reconstruct an initial version of the post. Null if title and argument are both missing or malformed.
